sentences.en: Your story only confirms my suspicions about your bad behavior.
sentences.zh: 你的故事只是证实了我对你的不良行为的怀疑。

sentences.en: They view foreigners with suspicion; I view everybody with suspicion.
sentences.zh: 他们对外国人充满疑心；我则对任何人都持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: They view foreigners with suspicion; I view everyone with suspicion.
sentences.zh: 他们对外国人充满疑心；我则对所有人都抱有怀疑。

senses.zh: 不好的预感，猜想；（对某人有罪、不诚实等的）怀疑；不信任，猜疑；少量，一点
